name: openrobot
tagline: A collaboration intake desk that turns interest into an intro email
description: For a project that keeps getting approached by people who want to work with it. The bot asks a short set of qualifying questions, writes the introduction email to the team on that person's behalf, and tells them what happens next so nobody is left waiting.
author: noborderhuman
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
